text: Chapter 10: The Lost God's Ship@The Duel in Nov Diela
■Next Mission\nMove from Nezim Wetlands to Nov Diela to start.
Nov Diela is overflowing with Juvestidas that\nwill swallow anyone who gets close to them.\nHead towards the center of the area while eliminating them!
Saria whom you have met before in\nGravel Terrace is trapped inside Juvestida.\nEliminate the monsters that get in the way and rescue Saria!
According to Saria, the residents of Nov Diela are\nholed up in the city center to avoid Coenubia's attacks.\nLet's hurry to save them!
Irestida, a Coenubia monster left behind by its progenitors,\nis intimidating the residents of Nov Diela. Exterminate it!
